hero.title: We create interiors with soul and story
hero.subtitle: From the first idea to the last detail. I design functional and timeless spaces that perfectly reflect your personality.
hero.badges: Karlovy Vary Region & all of Czechia | Premium materials | Individual approach

tile1.title: Design tailored to your personality
tile1.text: Every interior begins with understanding you — your pace, lifestyle, and the emotions you want to feel at home. Only then does the solution emerge — aesthetic, timeless, and precisely thought out.

tile2.title: 3D visualization that brings the future to the present
tile2.text: Before we start the realization, you will see every detail in a realistic form. No surprises — just certainty that the result will be exactly as you envisioned.

tile3.title: Style that stands the test of time
tile3.text: Quality and harmony are key for us. Trends come and go — your home should work and look great long-term.

project3.name: Scandinavian purity in a family house

services.title: The path to your dream home

design.title: Interior design
design.text: We create a comprehensive design concept including detailed 3D visualizations. Every element is thought through to be visually impressive and perfectly functional.

turnkey.title: Turnkey realization
turnkey.text: We ensure a complete transformation of your interior — from construction modifications, through custom furniture production to the final decorations. You just move into the finished space.

consultation.title: Personal consultation
consultation.text: For those who need a professional opinion, direction, or inspirational shift. We advise on layouts, colors, materials, and selection of statement pieces.

philosophy.title: Design that understands you
philosophy.text:
We create interiors that combine aesthetics, functionality, and the client's personal story.

We specialize in both design and complete interior realization — from concept, moodboard, and 3D visualizations to custom furniture and the final decoration.

We believe in design that is beautiful, thoughtful, and timeless. Every space is created individually, with respect for your needs, lifestyle, and uniqueness.
philosophy.pjgroup: We are part of the PJ Group — PJ Reality, PJ Reko, PJ Sprava, and PJ Design. Thanks to this, we offer a complete service under one roof: from rental and property management, through renovations to interior design.

step1.title: Initial consultation and needs analysis
step1.text: We meet in person or online. I'll learn about your ideas, priorities, and budget.

step2.title: Concept creation and layout design
step2.text: I'll prepare a moodboard and several layout variants that define the direction of the entire project.

step3.title: 3D visualization and material selection
step3.text: We'll present a realistic version of your future interior. Together we'll select materials, colors, textures, and furnishings.

step4.title: Technical documentation
step4.text: We'll prepare detailed documentation for craftsmen so that realization proceeds without errors and unnecessary improvisation.

step5.title: Design supervision or turnkey realization
step5.text: We'll oversee every step, or handle everything completely. The result is a perfectly coordinated space ready for immediate use.

glamour.description: Shine, luxurious materials, mirror surfaces, and dramatic elements.

industrial.description: Exposed bricks, concrete, metal, and the raw beauty of factory halls.

scandinavian.description: Light wood, simplicity, functionality, and the Nordic concept of coziness "hygge".

vintage.name: Vintage
vintage.description: Nostalgia, pieces with a story, and the elegance of old times in a modern interpretation.
